plan.estimand: Cluster-level rate difference in incidence per child-week (treatment vs control)
plan.hypothesis: Two-sided test of equal cluster-level rates: H₀: rate_treatment = rate_control vs H₁: rate_treatment ≠ rate_control
assumptions: Poisson rate model with over-dispersion characterized by between-cluster CV
Cluster exposure (child-weeks per cluster) is fixed at 2500
Between-cluster CV = 0.25 applies to both arms equally
Normal approximation valid for cluster-level rate differences
Additive one-cluster correction (k=1) applied to final design
Equal allocation ratio (1:1)
Two-sided significance test
scientific_notes: Calculation follows Field Trials of Health Interventions Chapter 5, Section 6.1 cluster-rate coefficient-of-variation approximation
This method accounts for cluster-level heterogeneity in rates via the between-cluster CV parameter
The one-cluster correction is an adjustment to account for the discrete nature of cluster counts
Treatment rate is 50% of control rate (0.005 vs 0.010)
